text:
ellie: Hey folks — anyone up for a Berlin brunch next Friday (Mitte/Rosenthaler area)? Ana's birthday that day so thinking cake + a casual spot. Non-dairy options would be ideal. Who's in? :birthday:

viraj: I'm in. Prefer somewhere with decent coffee and space for a small group. +1 for vegan cake options.

ana (ana): @ellie omg yes please! I love surprises but low-key with gluten-free option if possible.

carlos: Recommend 'Anna Blume' — short walk from the office, consistently good cakes and they do vegan cheesecakes. Might need a reservation for ~10.

marta: Also 'Father Carpenter' has a quieter vibe and brunchy savory plates if people want something beyond cake. Not sure about GF cakes though.

jamie: There's a small place 'Sugar & Salt' that does custom orders (vegan & GF). I ordered Ana's pastry last year, they do cute message toppers. Pricey but reliable.

ellie: Nice, OK let's narrow to options:
```
A) Anna Blume — walkable, cafe seating, vegan cake available
B) Father Carpenter — savory-first brunch + pastries
C) Sugar & Salt — custom cake (vegan/GF available), delivery or pickup
```

ellie: Vote with A/B/C reaction pls. I'll tabulate.

viraj: A for me.

carlos: A.

marta: C (leaning to custom so Ana gets GF option).

jamie: C.

ana (ana): Honestly A or C both great. I don't want fuss.

bistro-bot: Reminder: office calendar shows 11 people in that day. Would you like me to book a communal table? (reply 'book' to confirm)

ellie: @bistro-bot book please, tentatively for 11 at 11:30 — I'll finalize after poll.

carlos: If we go C, I can handle pickup and carry the cake. If A, I can try to call and reserve.

viraj: FYI Anna Blume sometimes closes early on Fridays — call first.

ellie: Poll results: A=2, B=0, C=2 (marta+jamie), others undecided. Looks split. Quick sanity check — how many prefer sit-down vs takeout-cake?

marta: I prefer custom cake (takeout) so everyone can grab coffee/table nearby.

jamie: Sit-down is nice but for speed + dietary control, custom cake wins.

ellie: OK final plan: I'll call Anna Blume to ask about a table for 11 at 11:30; if they can't accommodate GF/vegan cake needs, we'll order from Sugar & Salt and I will confirm pickup.

ana (ana): You guys are the best :heart_eyes: Thank you!!

ellie: Heads-up I made the call — Anna Blume has a small 11:30 slot but can't guarantee vegan custom cake. Sugar & Salt confirmed they can do a GF + vegan layer and deliver by 11:15 for pickup nearby. I'm leaning Sugar & Salt. Thoughts?

viraj: Go with the cake certainty — Sugar & Salt it is.

carlos: I'm happy to pick up. What cake message?

ellie: Simple: "Happy Birthday Ana" and a tiny smiley. Keep it low-key.

marta: I'll Venmo the cake share.

bistro-bot: Reservation: Anna Blume table still tentatively held for 11 at 11:30 for up to 12. Delivery option noted for Sugar & Salt at 11:15 if confirmed.

ellie: Great — I'm booking Sugar & Salt for a 10" round, vegan+GF layer, pickup at 11:15. Carlos can bring it to the office. RSVP in thread if you're coming so I can confirm headcount.

viraj: RSVP: in.

carlos: RSVP: in, I will pick up.

marta: RSVP: in, sending payment now.

jamie: RSVP: maybe (might be late), will try.

ellie: Thanks all — will update with confirmation number and Venmo details. :tada:
